title: Special Forces Camps, 1961–1971 — list
citation: Special Forces Camps, 1961-1971 - List, 10 pp, 1991. James L. Dickey Collection, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, item 30560102001.
notes: A tabulated list of U.S. Special Forces camps in South Vietnam by detachment, place, province, opening and closing date. Gives 'A-324 Nui Ba Den, Tay Ninh, Jul64 – Oct 70 closed', and for the province headquarters 'B-32 Tay Ninh, Mar65 – Nov 70 closed' with 'B-320 Tay Ninh (TDY), Mar 65, converted to PCS'.
